open_points.subject: store.read_value_bytes vs runs spool lifecycle
open_points.text: `store` must not own "when a run's spool is emptied or released (that is `runs`)"; but `store.read_value_bytes` says: "A spooled file whose run no longer holds its spool is refused."
open_points.question: Which module is authoritative for deciding whether a run "still holds its spool" at read time: `runs` or `store`?
options: `store` checks run/release state itself and refuses when spool should be unavailable
`runs` checks spool-hold state first and `store` only reads by explicit location/digest
open_points.default_guess: `store` enforces the final read-time refusal atomically, using run/release records, while `runs` remains owner of spool lifecycle transitions.
